blocks.text: Ek sehatmand janwar mein andar ke tissues, jaise khoon, dimagh, muscle waghera, aam tor par microorganisms (khurdbeeni jandaron) se paak hote hain. Doosri taraf satah (surface) ke tissues, jaise jild (skin) aur mucous membranes, hamesha mahol se mil rahe hote hain aur un par kuch khaas microbial species aabad (colonize) ho jati hain. Jism ki kisi bhi jagah par baqaidagi se milne wale jandaron ke mixture ko normal flora kehte hain.

blocks.title: Normal flora
blocks.text: Jism ki kisi khaas jagah (jaise jild, munh ya aant) par baqaidagi se milne wale microorganisms ka mixture.

Insanon ka normal flora bacteria, thore se fungi aur protists, aur kuch methanogenic archaea (methane gas banane wale archaea) par mushtamil hai. Normal flora mein bacteria sab se zyada tadaad mein hain aur sab se numayan (wazeh) hain.
Insanon ke bacterial flora ke faide

Insanon aur un ke normal flora ka rishta mutualistic hai, yani dono ko faida hota hai. Insani jism mein normal flora ko khoraak (nutrients), ek mustaqil (stable) mahol aur ek jaisa temperature, hifazat aur ek jagah se doosri jagah pohanchne (transport) ki sahoolat milti hai. Isi tarah jism ko bhi normal bacteria se bohat se faide milte hain; maslan:

items: Vitamins banana: Alimentary canal (khoraak ki nali) ke bacteria vitamins banate hain. Jo vitamins un ki zaroorat se zyada hon, woh bahar nikal dete hain. Yeh vitamins alimentary canal se jazb (absorb) ho kar jism mein phail jate hain. Maslan, enteric bacteria (aant ke bacteria) Vitamin K aur Vitamin B₁₂ nikalte hain, aur lactic acid bacteria kuch B-vitamins banate hain.

Pathogens ko aabad hone se rokna: Normal flora ke bacteria chipakne ki jagahon (attachment sites) aur khoraak ke liye pathogens (bimari wale jaraseem) se muqabla karte hain. Is liye pathogens ko jism ke tissues mein dakhil hone ka mauqa kam milta hai.
Pathogens ko rokna ya maarna: Aant ke bacteria kai qisam ke maadde banate hain jo pathogen bacteria ko rokte ya maar dete hain.

Cross-reactive antibodies banwana: Normal flora antigens (aisi cheezein jin ke khilaf jism antibodies banata hai) ki tarah kaam karta hai, is liye yeh jism mein immune response (difa ka jawab) paida karta hai. Normal flora ke khilaf bani thori si antibodies kuch pathogens se bhi cross-react karti hain (un se bhi jur jati hain), aur is tarah infection ya hamle ko rok deti hain.

blocks.prompt: Normal flora pathogens ko jism se door rakhne ke do tareeqe aur do vitamins batayein jo yeh deta hai.
blocks.explanation: Yeh chipakne ki jagahon aur khoraak ke liye pathogens se muqabla karta hai, aur aise maadde banata hai jo pathogens ko rokte ya maarte hain (is ke khilaf bani antibodies bhi kuch pathogens se cross-react karti hain). Enteric bacteria Vitamin K aur Vitamin B₁₂ dete hain; lactic acid bacteria kuch B-vitamins banate hain.

items: Andar ke tissues aam tor par microbes se paak hote hain; satah ke tissues par normal flora hota hai: zyadatar bacteria, thore fungi aur protists, aur kuch methanogenic archaea.
Rishta mutualistic hai: flora ko khoraak, mustaqil mahol aur temperature, hifazat aur transport milta hai.
Jism ko vitamins (K, B₁₂, kuch B-vitamins), pathogens ke aabad hone se bachao, pathogen maarne wale maadde aur cross-reactive antibodies milti hain.
